title: Progress of Circle Line MRT Tunnel Reinforcement Works
what_it_is: Progress of Circle Line MRT Tunnel Reinforcement Works

sections.label: Steel ring installation progress
sections.summary: About 50% of required steel rings are installed as at end-February 2026, with works on schedule to complete by 19 April 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: As at end-February 2026, about 50% of the required steel rings have been installed.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Transport (Mr Jeffrey Siow)
sentences.text: Works are being carried out at a pace that will ensure the safety of our workers and commuters, and we remain on schedule to complete them by 19 April 2026, which is what we have committed.

sections.label: Project timelines and commuter alternatives
sections.summary: The project remains on track and cannot be brought forward, alternatives are provided for commuters, and more intensive works are needed as the network ages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: At the moment, our assessment is that it remains on track, that it is not possible for us to bring the project timelines forward.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: This is really because the works are complex and we want to ensure that the safety of the workers and the people involved are prioritised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: On his second question, I think what we have done is to provide alternatives for our commuters as far as we can.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: There are adjustments that commuters will have to make in terms of their travel routes, but there are alternatives on both the train and the buses, and these are sufficient for us to accommodate the alternative travel plans that commuters need to make, whenever we have to do these works.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: Going forward, we will have to do these works across the board, for the network, in a more intensive and widespread fashion, because our train network is ageing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: And so, we seek the commuters' support and understanding that this is quite normal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Jeffrey Siow
sentences.text: I think no other train system in the world offers travel rebates when doing such maintenance works; and I think it is commonly accepted that this is part of the way we try to do our best to sustain the efficiency, the reliability, as well as the financial sustainability of the public transport system.
